Staff.title: Staff
Staff.description: Represents a staff member in the WorkWise application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Staff entity.

name.description: The name of the staff member.

calendarId.description: The ID of the Google Calendar associated with the staff member.

colorKey.description: Color key for the staff member's work schedule representation.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer in the WorkWise application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

userCode.description: The user code for the customer.

storeName.description: The name of the customer's store.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer.

businessHours.description: The business hours of the customer's store.

WorkSchedule.title: WorkSchedule
WorkSchedule.description: Represents a work schedule entry in the WorkWise application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkSchedule entity.

startTime.description: The start time of the work schedule.

endTime.description: The end time of the work schedule.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents a work location in the WorkWise application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

address.description: The address of the work location.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the work location.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the work location.

EmployeeAction.title: EmployeeAction
EmployeeAction.description: Represents an action performed by an employee during a workday.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmployeeAction entity.

actionType.description: The type of action performed (e.g., Arrive, Begin Task, Finish Task, Depart).

locationId.description: Reference to Location. (Relationship: Location 1:N EmployeeAction) The location where the action was performed.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to be secure, scalable, and debuggable, adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC (Database-Based Access Control), and QAPs (Rules are not Filters). It leverages denormalization for authorization and structural segregation to simplify security rules and enable secure list operations. The structure is organized around the core entities: Staff, Customer, WorkSchedule, Location, and EmployeeAction. Path-based ownership is used where appropriate. The Membership Map approach is not applicable here since there are no collaborative entities.
